svg.title: What a tool call passes through, inbound and outbound
svg.desc: A model's tool call enters at the outermost wrapper and unwinds back out through the same stack. Artifact spill is outermost, so it sees the final content; secret masking is innermost, so it redacts before any other wrapper reads output. Approvals can suspend the call and wait for a human decision, and policies, command screening, content screening, limits and guardrails can each deny it outright — a denial short-circuits the rest of the stack and returns a deny_output to the model. Command screening can also require approval rather than deny outright, so a run can be suspended from two places in the stack. Only controls the manifest enables are installed, with one exception: limits is always applied, because gating it on any_limit() once left manifests with no tool-call cap, no wall clock, and no spend ceiling.
